_about: Page wording that replaces version 1 wording which would be wrong for version 2. DRAFTS awaiting the owner's approval (owner decision, 2026-11-26, item 5). Every other label on the page is version 1's own, copied as it is. {model} and {seconds} are filled in by the page.
empty_chat_caption: Request a table or chart. {model} · AI reads each typed request; every figure comes from a query of the IPEDS data, never from the AI.
about_intro: Plain-English answers about U.S. colleges from ten annual IPEDS releases, with the codebooks' own definitions.
model_caption: Haiku reads each question and writes the short summary under each answer. Sonnet reads questions more slowly and costs more. Either way, the AI only reads the question: every figure comes from a query the app builds, and every summary is checked against its table.
ai_caption: The AI sends your question, the IPEDS measures, schools and terms that may fit it, and your last five requests in this conversation to Anthropic. For the written summary, the answer's table is sent too. Memory lasts for this session; Clear conversation clears it. Queries and calculations stay local.
benchmark_caption: Each published figure is compared year by year across the ten releases. Questions the app declines or does not cover are not counted. Remaining differences are documented source, universe or definition differences, not arbitrary errors; benchmarks test data retrieval, not open-ended conversation accuracy.
definitions_intro: Search the IPEDS codebooks to learn what a field means and which table contains it. Use the conversation for institution statistics.
evidence_caption: Ranked codebook records, not an exhaustive inventory.
error_limit: The app has reached its usage limit for now, so it can't read new questions. Explore IPEDS and the definitions browser still work. Please try again later.
error_access: The selected model isn't available right now. Choose the other model under About this prototype, or try again later.
error_timeout: Reading this question took longer than {seconds} seconds, so it was stopped. No partial result was published. Please try again, or ask it in a shorter way.
error_down: The AI service couldn't be reached. No partial result was published. Please try again in a minute.
error_app: The request could not finish. No partial result was published. Please try again, or ask it another way.
error_database: The IPEDS database isn't available, so the app can't answer questions. If you run the app yourself, build the database first: python build/build_data.py
